skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Sweetness to the Heart
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sweetness to the Heart. Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?
skins.quote: After trying the desserts Nymph brought along, there is not a soul who is not wondering about the secret behind their incredible sweetness.

skins.name: 찬란한 환상곡
skins.content: 앰비언스 시네스티시아 시리즈 - 찬란한 환상곡. 님프가 고른 새틴 드레스. 나풀거리는 연한 색 치맛자락은 꽃봉오리 모양으로 묶은 머리와 어우러져 그녀를 마치 정원에서 춤추는 요정처럼 가볍고 경쾌하게 만들어줍니다.
skins.quote: 아치형 복도를 지나고, 작은 다리를 건너, 다시 관목숲 속 모퉁이를 지나왔다. 하지만 정원 그 어디를 지나오든, 온갖 꽃 중에서 가장 눈길을 끄는 꽃은 바로 그녀다.
